name: Arcturus CorpSec Tier-2 Response Uniform
description:
The standard-issue response uniform for Arcturus security contractors working Tier 2 patrol zones. Built around a graphene-weave underlayer bonded to rigid UHMWPE plate inserts at the chest, shoulders, and forearms, the suit offers ballistic protection rated to standard pistol calibers without the bulk of full tactical kit. The coloring is Arcturus's signature matte charcoal with high-vis amber trim on the shoulder panels — visible enough to deter, dark enough to blend in low-light corridor sweeps. Every seam is double-stitched with conductive thread that routes biomonitor data to the contractor's BCI overlay.

The uniform ships with pre-cut port-access panels at the left forearm and base of the skull, compatible with the most common BCI and neural-link hardware on the market. A reinforced tail-loop seam runs along the posterior hem for geneware-modified personnel, and the collar sits wide enough to clear standard-grade horn implants. Arcturus contractors are required to wear this or the MK-7 line while on duty; wearing it off-duty in Tier 1 zones is a known intimidation tactic.
cultural_context: Shelf residents know this uniform means a sweep is happening. Tier 2 workers view Arcturus contractors with cautious deference — they're not cops, but they have more authority than cops in most corporate zones. The amber trim has become shorthand in street slang for 'watch yourself.'
story_hooks: A contractor's uniform goes missing from a locker room in a Tier 2 housing block — someone is impersonating Arcturus security, and the real question is whether Arcturus wants them caught or quietly disappeared.
A former Arcturus contractor still wears her uniform jacket off-duty, the Arcturus patch removed but the silhouette unmistakable. It keeps people from bothering her. Until it doesn't.
The biomonitor thread in a dead contractor's uniform recorded his final 40 minutes. Someone wants that data pulled before the official investigation does.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, militaristic bodysuit with pronounced angular shoulders and a tapered waist. The matte charcoal base creates a shadow-like silhouette broken only by high-vis amber accent panels running across the shoulders and upper back. Reads as 'armed professional' — intimidating but refined, not brutish.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tailored through the torso and limbs, allowing full mobility without excess fabric. The chest and shoulders are slightly built-up by internal plating, creating a subtly armored profile. Collar is wide and sits high on the neck.
physical_description.primary_material: Graphene-weave composite bonded to rigid UHMWPE (ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene) plate inserts at critical impact zones. Outer facing is treated synthetic microfiber for ballistic abrasion resistance.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost laminated surface with faint woven pattern visible under direct light. Plate areas have slightly raised edges where bonding seams run. Conductive thread tracery is subtle but tactile along major seams.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte charcoal-gray with Arcturus signature high-vis amber stripes running horizontally across shoulder panels and upper back. No logos visible — the uniform itself is the brand marker.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap system down the front centerline with friction-fit reinforcement panels. Wrist and ankle cuffs use micro-tension bands. Reinforced tail-loop seam at posterior hem for compatibility with rear-mounted augmentation.
distinctive_features: Pre-cut neural interface ports at left forearm and base of skull (standard-grade BCI compatible)
Double-stitched conductive threading routing biomonitor data throughout
Reinforced posterior seam loop for geneware-modified spinal hardware
UHMWPE plate inserts at chest, shoulders, and forearms with visible bonding edges
Wide collar clearance for grade-standard horn implants
High-visibility amber banding that serves as visual intimidation and zone identification
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 corporate authority — too refined and expensive for working-class wear, but militant enough to signal enforcement rather than leisure or service roles.
physical_description.cultural_context: Arcturus CorpSec contractor uniform. Wearer is an armed security professional with legal authority in Tier 2 zones. Street reading: enforcement, surveillance, not to be crossed. Off-duty wearing in Tier 1 zones carries implicit threat value.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when issued; worn examples show scuff marks on plates and fading of amber trim from ambient ionization. Conductive seams may show minor discoloration from biomonitor signal stress.
